title: Package Manifest
description: The ordered software recipe for one image baseline. An image recipe, not deployment policy: it carries no assignments, schedules, audience targeting, update channels, or dependency resolution.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Incremented when a change is not backward compatible.

id.description: Stable identifier for the package within this manifest.

version.description: Exact version. No ranges, wildcards, or 'latest'.

source.description: Exact source reference, relative to the qualified source root. Only the file scheme is resolvable in this schema version.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256, established before build runtime. Never computed at runtime and then treated as expected.

order.description: Deterministic ordering key. Must be unique within the manifest.

required.description: Whether qualification failure for this package fails the build.
